suggestions.quote: In terms of part-time education, approximately 1,000 thousand males were in education in 1970/71. This figure fluctuated slightly, dropping to roughly 850 thousand in 1980/81 before rising again to around 900 thousand by 1990/91. By contrast, the number of female part-time students began at only around 700 thousand in 1970/71, but grew substantially over the two decades, exceeding 1,100 thousand in 1990/91 and surpassing male numbers.
